name: Amagi Karin
source:
"You’re the only one I let play with my ears, you know?"

A Tenko, and somewhat of a mischievous flirt that prefers to go by Karin. She’s rambunctious and vivacious, and in a manner of speaking, unrefined. When speaking with [url=/c14905]Yuuta[/url] she tends to speak her mind, and isn’t shy about making her feelings known. Never fear, though, because her honesty is the genuine thing. 

[url=/c14899]Luce[/url] is somewhat of a childhood rival, and both are always quarreling about something. Of course, they’re not truly enemies. 

Karin has traveled to the human world to fulfill the love pact she made with Yuuta. Unlike the other girls, she’s laidback about the marriage proposal, and thinks Yuuta should just seal the deal with her posthaste. 

She will be entering Shinonome Academy as a 2nd year student. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1049]MangaGamer[/url]]
